profile.headline: Software Engineer II
profile.summary: Post-graduate looking for work or internships in Computer Science. Also have experience in social media management and some graphic design. Graduated from CPP with a BS in Computer Science. Worked as Director of Marketing for Bronco Esports from 2019-2020.

positions.title: GCS Back-End Developer
positions.description:
● Assisted in the development of the backend for the Ground Control System using Python.

● Worked on saving and storing real-time vehicle data for three autonomous vehicles into a database with the use of SQLite.

● Collaborated with clients in order to fulfill project requirements as well as perform maintenance on code base on a routine basis.

positions.title: Director of Marketing
positions.description:
● Edited images for club advertisements and managed social media accounts, increasing club Discord members by 300+.

● Communicated with sponsors and partners for instructions and
resources.

● Helped lead and organize volunteers for on-campus events that hold
around 300 attendees.

honors.title: Magna Cum Laude
honors.description:
Cal Poly Pomona grants honors upon graduation to students who have demonstrated academic excellence throughout their undergraduate careers.

Magna Cum Laude: 3.65 - 3.79
